metrics.name: False Match Rate
metrics.definition: Proportion of zero-effort impostor comparisons incorrectly accepted at decision threshold theta.
metrics.formula: Count(Impostor Comparisons with score >= theta) / Total Impostor Comparisons
metrics.zero_error_reporting: Report Rule of Three upper bound 3/N, never 0.0%

metrics.name: False Non-Match Rate
metrics.definition: Proportion of genuine comparisons incorrectly rejected at decision threshold theta.
metrics.formula: Count(Genuine Comparisons with score < theta) / Total Genuine Comparisons

metrics.name: True Accept Rate
metrics.definition: Proportion of genuine comparisons correctly accepted at target operating FMR.

metrics.name: Failure to Acquire
metrics.definition: Proportion of capture attempts where face detection or landmark quality check fails.
metrics.formula: Count(Unusable Capture Attempts) / Total Presentation Attempts

metrics.name: Failure to Enroll
metrics.definition: Proportion of eligible enrollment attempts that cannot generate an enrolled template within allowed retries.
metrics.formula: Count(Failed Enrollment Sessions) / Total Eligible Applicant Enrollment Sessions

metrics.name: False Positive Identification Rate
metrics.definition: Proportion of non-mated 1:N searches returning at least one candidate hit above threshold theta.
metrics.formula: Count(Searches where max score >= theta) / Total Non-Mated Searches

metrics.name: False Negative Identification Rate
metrics.definition: Proportion of mated 1:N searches failing to return the true matching identity within candidate list criteria.
metrics.formula: Count(Searches where true mate is omitted or score < theta) / Total Mated Searches
